driver_archetypes.rationale: Saval et al. 2023 Table 11 (Car): calibrated IDM parameters for standard Hanoi cars; high tau reflects patience with queues.
Car violators drawn from the car distribution; currently passive (params=car_saval) to maintain population balance until P1/B2 tuning.
Saval et al. 2023 Table 11 (Motorcycle): high accel/decel, low tau for aggressive following; minGapLat=0.3m reflects the 'narrow lane' observation.
Motorcycle violators drawn from the moto distribution; currently passive to maintain population balance until P1/B2 tuning.
Illegal-left motorcycles (distribution moto_violator); base parameters match Saval et al., jmTimegapMinor defaults to allow box-waiting logic.

traci_rules.rationale: Saval et al. 2023 Sec 4: motorcycles at the stop line have ~50% chance to run red (p0=p_max=0.5); k=0 reflects no observed swarm effect.
Targets M2/early/moto (0.13 share): moto_saval is the main population; p=0.13 sets ~13% early-start probability in the last 10s of red to match observations.
Structure locked for Phase 1; all p=0 because sidewalk (M10a) requires tuning later and wrong-lane/right-lane options are site-restricted.
Field observation: cars rarely squeeze past a standing U-turner (low p=0.1); t_wait=2s is a conservative hold time.
Field observation: most motorcycles squeeze past a standing U-turner (high p=0.8); t_wait=2s is a conservative hold time.
